answer: An agent marketplace requires every bidding identity to lock 100 tokens in a contract for 30 days, with no withdrawal or reuse during that period. Agents such as zephyr and yarrow can trade freely, but each new identity needs its own funded bond. This ties every thread of a sybil swarm to scarce capital: creating 1,000 eligible identities immobilizes 100,000 tokens, making fake accounts costly rather than free.
